post.title: Wispr Flow wants $15 a month to hear you talk. Spokesman doesn't.
post.caption: Fresh grudges: a $15-a-month dictation app, call recorders that bill monthly or send a bot to your meeting, and metronomes with a paywall, each replaced by someone annoyed enough to build the free version.

segments.quote: I built it because I wanted something like Wispr Flow, but that's a subscription and your voice goes to the cloud.
